live.canon|genesis|34:24: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.
live.canon|genesis|34:25: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.
live.canon|genesis|34:26: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went out.
live.canon|genesis|34:27: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.
live.canon|genesis|34:28: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,
live.canon|genesis|34:29: And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that was in the house.
live.canon|genesis|34:31: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?
live.canon|genesis|35:1: And Elohim (God) said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Beth-el, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto Elohim (God), that appeared unto you when you fleddest from the face of Esau your brother.
live.canon|genesis|35:10: And Elohim (God) said unto him, Your name is Jacob: your name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Yashar'el (Israel) shall be your name: and he called his name Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|genesis|35:11: And Elohim (God) said unto him, I am El Shaddai (God Almighty): be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of you, and kings shall come out of your loins;
live.canon|genesis|35:12: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to you I will give it, and to your seed after you will I give the land.
live.canon|genesis|35:17: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; you shall have this son also.
live.canon|genesis|35:2: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:
live.canon|genesis|35:3: And let us arise, and go up to Beth-el; and I will make there an altar unto Elohim (God), who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.
live.canon|genesis|35:4: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
live.canon|genesis|35:5: And they journeyed: and the terror of Elohim (God) was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.
live.canon|genesis|35:6: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Beth-el, he and all the people that were with him.
live.canon|genesis|35:7: And he built there an altar, and called the place El-beth-el: because there Elohim (God) appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
live.canon|genesis|35:8: But Deborah Rebekah’s nurse died, and she was buried beneath Beth-el under an oak: and the name of it was called Allon-bachuth.
live.canon|genesis|35:9: And Elohim (God) appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padan-aram, and blessed him.
live.canon|genesis|35:13: And Elohim (God) went up from him in the place where he talked with him.
live.canon|genesis|35:14: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.
live.canon|genesis|35:15: And Jacob called the name of the place where Elohim (God) spake with him, Beth-el.
live.canon|genesis|35:16: And they journeyed from Beth-el; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.
live.canon|genesis|35:18: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Ben-oni: but his father called him Benjamin.
live.canon|genesis|35:19: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Beth-lehem.
live.canon|genesis|35:20: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel’s grave unto this day.
live.canon|genesis|35:21: And Yashar'el (Israel) journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.
live.canon|genesis|35:22: And it came to pass, when Yashar'el (Israel) dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father’s concubine: and Yashar'el (Israel) heard it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:
live.canon|genesis|35:23: The sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Yahudah (Judah), and Issachar, and Zebulun:
live.canon|genesis|35:24: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:
live.canon|genesis|35:25: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:
live.canon|genesis|35:26: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s handmaid; Gad, and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob, which were born to him in Padan-aram.
live.canon|genesis|35:27: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.
live.canon|genesis|35:28: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.
live.canon|genesis|35:29: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
live.canon|genesis|36:1: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.
live.canon|genesis|36:2: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;
live.canon|genesis|36:3: And Bashemath Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebajoth.
live.canon|genesis|36:4: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;
live.canon|genesis|36:5: And Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.
live.canon|genesis|36:6: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had got in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob.
live.canon|genesis|36:7: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together; and the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.
live.canon|genesis|36:8: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.
live.canon|genesis|36:9: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:
live.canon|genesis|36:10: These are the names of Esau’s sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.
live.canon|genesis|36:11: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
live.canon|genesis|36:12: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau’s son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these were the sons of Adah Esau’s wife.
live.canon|genesis|36:13: And these are the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau’s wife.
live.canon|genesis|36:14: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
live.canon|genesis|36:15: These were dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau; duke Teman, duke Omar, duke Zepho, duke Kenaz,
live.canon|genesis|36:16: Duke Korah, duke Gatam, and duke Amalek: these are the dukes that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these were the sons of Adah.
live.canon|genesis|36:17: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau’s son; duke Nahath, duke Zerah, duke Shammah, duke Mizzah: these are the dukes that came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Bashemath Esau’s wife.
live.canon|genesis|36:18: And these are the sons of Aholibamah Esau’s wife; duke Jeush, duke Jaalam, duke Korah: these were the dukes that came of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.
live.canon|genesis|36:19: These are the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these are their dukes.
live.canon|genesis|36:20: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,
live.canon|genesis|36:21: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these are the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
live.canon|genesis|36:22: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan’s sister was Timna.
live.canon|genesis|36:23: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
live.canon|genesis|36:24: And these are the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.
live.canon|genesis|36:25: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.
live.canon|genesis|36:26: And these are the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
live.canon|genesis|36:27: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.
live.canon|genesis|36:28: The children of Dishan are these; Uz, and Aran.
live.canon|genesis|36:29: These are the dukes that came of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,
live.canon|genesis|36:30: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these are the dukes that came of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.
live.canon|genesis|36:31: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|genesis|36:32: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
live.canon|genesis|36:33: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
live.canon|genesis|36:34: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.
live.canon|genesis|36:35: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
live.canon|genesis|36:36: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
live.canon|genesis|36:37: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
live.canon|genesis|36:38: And Saul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
live.canon|genesis|36:39: And Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
live.canon|genesis|36:40: And these are the names of the dukes that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,
live.canon|genesis|36:41: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
live.canon|genesis|36:42: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
live.canon|genesis|36:43: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these be the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he is Esau the father of the Edomites.
live.canon|genesis|37:10: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that you have dreamed? Shall I and your mother and your brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to you to the earth?
live.canon|genesis|37:13: And Yashar'el (Israel) said unto Joseph, Do not your brethren feed the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send you unto them. And he said to him, Here am I.
live.canon|genesis|37:14: And he said to him, Go, I pray you, see whether it be well with your brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
live.canon|genesis|37:15: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seek you?
live.canon|genesis|37:16: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray you, where they feed their flocks.
live.canon|genesis|37:19: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer comes.
live.canon|genesis|37:20: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into some pit, and we will say, Some evil beast has devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.
live.canon|genesis|37:1: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan.
live.canon|genesis|37:2: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father’s wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.
live.canon|genesis|37:3: Now Yashar'el (Israel) loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.
live.canon|genesis|37:4: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.
live.canon|genesis|37:5: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.
live.canon|genesis|37:6: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:
live.canon|genesis|37:7: For, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.
live.canon|genesis|37:9: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.
live.canon|genesis|37:11: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.
live.canon|genesis|37:12: And his brethren went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.
live.canon|genesis|37:17: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.
live.canon|genesis|37:18: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.
live.canon|genesis|37:21: And Reuben heard it, and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.
live.canon|genesis|37:8: And his brethren said to him, Shall you indeed reign over us? or shall you indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.
live.canon|genesis|37:22: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again.
live.canon|genesis|37:23: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stript Joseph out of his coat, his coat of many colours that was on him;
live.canon|genesis|37:24: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.
live.canon|genesis|37:25: And they sat down to eat bread: and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a company of Ishmeelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.
live.canon|genesis|37:26: And Yahudah (Judah) said unto his brethren, What profit is it if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?
live.canon|genesis|37:27: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.
live.canon|genesis|37:28: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.
live.canon|genesis|37:29: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.
live.canon|genesis|37:30: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, whither shall I go?
live.canon|genesis|37:31: And they took Joseph’s coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;
live.canon|genesis|37:34: And Jacob rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.
live.canon|genesis|37:35: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning. Thus his father wept for him.
live.canon|genesis|37:36: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, and captain of the guard.
live.canon|genesis|37:32: And they sent the coat of many colours, and they brought it to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it be your son’s coat or no.
live.canon|genesis|37:33: And he knew it, and said, It is my son’s coat; an evil beast has devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces.
live.canon|genesis|38:24: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Yahudah (Judah), saying, Tamar your daughter in law has played the harlot; and also, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Yahudah (Judah) said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.
live.canon|genesis|38:25: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray you, whose are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.
live.canon|genesis|38:26: And Yahudah (Judah) acknowledged them, and said, She has been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.
live.canon|genesis|38:29: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How have you broken forth? this breach be upon you: therefore his name was called Pharez.
live.canon|genesis|38:1: And it came to pass at that time, that Yahudah (Judah) went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
live.canon|genesis|38:2: And Yahudah (Judah) saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name was Shuah; and he took her, and went in unto her.
live.canon|genesis|38:3: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.
live.canon|genesis|38:4: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.
live.canon|genesis|38:5: And she yet again conceived, and bare a son; and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.
live.canon|genesis|38:6: And Yahudah (Judah) took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name was Tamar.
live.canon|genesis|38:7: And Er, Yahudah's (Judah’s) firstborn, was wicked in the sight of Yahuah (LORD); and Yahuah (LORD) slew him.
live.canon|genesis|38:9: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother’s wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.
live.canon|genesis|38:10: And the thing which he did displeased Yahuah (LORD): wherefore he slew him also.
live.canon|genesis|38:12: And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Yahudah's (Judah’s) wife died; and Yahudah (Judah) was comforted, and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnath, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.
live.canon|genesis|38:14: And she put her widow’s garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.
live.canon|genesis|38:15: When Yahudah (Judah) saw her, he thought her to be an harlot; because she had covered her face.
live.canon|genesis|38:19: And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
live.canon|genesis|38:8: And Yahudah (Judah) said unto Onan, Go in unto your brother’s wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to your brother.
live.canon|genesis|38:11: Then said Yahudah (Judah) to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at your father’s house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren did. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father’s house.
live.canon|genesis|38:13: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold your father in law goes up to Timnath to shear his sheep.
live.canon|genesis|38:16: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray you, let me come in unto you; (for he knew not that she was his daughter in law.) And she said, What will you give me, that you may come in unto me?
live.canon|genesis|38:17: And he said, I will send you a kid from the flock. And she said, Will you give me a pledge, till you send it?
live.canon|genesis|38:18: And he said, What pledge shall I give you? And she said, Your signet, and your bracelets, and your staff that is in your hand. And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.
live.canon|genesis|38:20: And Yahudah (Judah) sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive his pledge from the woman’s hand: but he found her not.
live.canon|genesis|38:21: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where is the harlot, that was openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in this place.
live.canon|genesis|38:22: And he returned to Yahudah (Judah), and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, that there was no harlot in this place.
live.canon|genesis|38:27: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.
live.canon|genesis|38:28: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that the one put out his hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.
live.canon|genesis|38:30: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zarah.
live.canon|genesis|38:23: And Yahudah (Judah) said, Let her take it to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and you have not found her.
live.canon|genesis|39:8: But he refused, and said unto his master’s wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what is with me in the house, and he has committed all that he has to my hand;
live.canon|genesis|39:9: There is none greater in this house than I; neither has he kept back any thing from me but you, because you are his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against Elohim (God)?
live.canon|genesis|39:14: That she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them, saying, See, he has brought in an Hebrew unto us to mock us; he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:
live.canon|genesis|39:17: And she spake unto him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant, which you have brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:
live.canon|genesis|39:19: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did your servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.
live.canon|genesis|39:1: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmeelites, which had brought him down thither.
live.canon|genesis|39:2: And Yahuah (LORD) was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
live.canon|genesis|39:3: And his master saw that Yahuah (LORD) was with him, and that Yahuah (LORD) made all that he did to prosper in his hand.
live.canon|genesis|39:4: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.
live.canon|genesis|39:5: And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that Yahuah (LORD) blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake; and the blessing of Yahuah (LORD) was upon all that he had in the house, and in the field.
live.canon|genesis|39:6: And he left all that he had in Joseph’s hand; and he knew not ought he had, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was a goodly person, and well favoured.
live.canon|genesis|39:7: And it came to pass after these things, that his master’s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.
live.canon|genesis|39:10: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.
live.canon|genesis|39:11: And it came to pass about this time, that Joseph went into the house to do his business; and there was none of the men of the house there within.
live.canon|genesis|39:12: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.
live.canon|genesis|39:13: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,
live.canon|genesis|39:15: And it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled, and got him out.
live.canon|genesis|39:16: And she laid up his garment by her, until his lord came home.
live.canon|genesis|39:18: And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled out.
live.canon|genesis|39:20: And Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king’s prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.
live.canon|genesis|39:21: But Yahuah (LORD) was with Joseph, and shewed him mercy, and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
live.canon|genesis|39:22: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it.
live.canon|genesis|39:23: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing that was under his hand; because Yahuah (LORD) was with him, and that which he did, Yahuah (LORD) made it to prosper.
live.canon|genesis|40:7: And he asked Pharaoh’s officers that were with him in the ward of his lord’s house, saying, Wherefore look you so sadly to day?
live.canon|genesis|40:13: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up your head, and restore you unto your place: and you shall deliver Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, after the former manner when you were his butler.
live.canon|genesis|40:14: But think on me when it shall be well with you, and shew kindness, I pray you, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house:
live.canon|genesis|40:19: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up your head from off you, and shall hang you on a tree; and the birds shall eat your flesh from off you.
live.canon|genesis|40:1: And it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt.
live.canon|genesis|40:2: And Pharaoh was wroth against two of his officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.
live.canon|genesis|40:3: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.
live.canon|genesis|40:4: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them: and they continued a season in ward.
live.canon|genesis|40:5: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, which were bound in the prison.
live.canon|genesis|40:6: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and looked upon them, and, behold, they were sad.
live.canon|genesis|40:8: And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and there is no interpreter of it. And Joseph said unto them, Do not interpretations belong to Elohim (God)? tell me them, I pray you.
live.canon|genesis|40:9: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine was before me;
live.canon|genesis|40:10: And in the vine were three branches: and it was as though it budded, and her blossoms shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:
live.canon|genesis|40:11: And Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand: and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.
live.canon|genesis|40:12: And Joseph said unto him, This is the interpretation of it: The three branches are three days:
live.canon|genesis|40:15: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews: and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.
live.canon|genesis|40:16: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, I had three white baskets on my head:
live.canon|genesis|40:17: And in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.
live.canon|genesis|40:18: And Joseph answered and said, This is the interpretation thereof: The three baskets are three days:
live.canon|genesis|40:20: And it came to pass the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.
live.canon|genesis|40:21: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand:
live.canon|genesis|40:22: But he hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.
live.canon|genesis|40:23: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.
live.canon|genesis|41:13: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto my office, and him he hanged.
live.canon|genesis|41:15: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of you, that you can understand a dream to interpret it.
live.canon|genesis|41:25: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: Elohim (God) has shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do.
live.canon|genesis|41:28: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What Elohim (God) is about to do he shows unto Pharaoh.
live.canon|genesis|41:39: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as Elohim (God) has shewed you all this, there is none so discreet and wise as you are:
live.canon|genesis|41:40: You shall be over my house, and according unto your word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than you.
live.canon|genesis|41:41: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.
live.canon|genesis|41:44: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without you shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.
live.canon|genesis|41:51: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For Elohim (God), said he, has made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.
live.canon|genesis|41:52: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For Elohim (God) has caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.
live.canon|genesis|41:55: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he says to you, do.
live.canon|genesis|41:1: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.
live.canon|genesis|41:2: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed; and they fed in a meadow.
live.canon|genesis|41:3: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill favoured and leanfleshed; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river.
live.canon|genesis|41:4: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.
live.canon|genesis|41:5: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.
live.canon|genesis|41:6: And, behold, seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them.
live.canon|genesis|41:7: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.
live.canon|genesis|41:8: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.
live.canon|genesis|41:9: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:
live.canon|genesis|41:10: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the captain of the guard’s house, both me and the chief baker:
live.canon|genesis|41:11: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.
live.canon|genesis|41:12: And there was there with us a young man, an Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.
live.canon|genesis|41:14: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved himself, and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.
live.canon|genesis|41:16: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: Elohim (God) shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.
live.canon|genesis|41:17: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon the bank of the river:
live.canon|genesis|41:18: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fatfleshed and well favoured; and they fed in a meadow:
live.canon|genesis|41:19: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness:
live.canon|genesis|41:20: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:
live.canon|genesis|41:21: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill favoured, as at the beginning. So I awoke.
live.canon|genesis|41:22: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up in one stalk, full and good:
live.canon|genesis|41:23: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:
live.canon|genesis|41:24: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.
live.canon|genesis|41:26: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.
live.canon|genesis|41:27: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.
live.canon|genesis|41:29: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:
live.canon|genesis|41:30: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;
live.canon|genesis|41:31: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.
live.canon|genesis|41:32: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by Elohim (God), and Elohim (God) will shortly bring it to pass.
live.canon|genesis|41:33: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.
live.canon|genesis|41:34: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.
live.canon|genesis|41:35: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.
live.canon|genesis|41:36: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.
live.canon|genesis|41:37: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
live.canon|genesis|41:38: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this is, a man in whom the Spirit of Elohim (God) is?
live.canon|genesis|41:42: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;
live.canon|genesis|41:43: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.
live.canon|genesis|41:45: And Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphnath-paaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.
live.canon|genesis|41:46: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
live.canon|genesis|41:47: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.
live.canon|genesis|41:48: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.
live.canon|genesis|41:49: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.
live.canon|genesis|41:50: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.
live.canon|genesis|41:53: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.
live.canon|genesis|41:54: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
live.canon|genesis|41:56: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: and Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.
live.canon|genesis|41:57: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.
live.canon|genesis|42:1: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do you look one upon another?
live.canon|genesis|42:7: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them; and he said unto them, Whence come you? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.
live.canon|genesis|42:9: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, You are spies; to see the nakedness of the land you are come.
live.canon|genesis|42:10: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are your servants come.
live.canon|genesis|42:11: We are all one man’s sons; we are true men, your servants are no spies.
live.canon|genesis|42:12: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land you are come.
live.canon|genesis|42:13: And they said, Your servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.
live.canon|genesis|42:14: And Joseph said unto them, That is it that I spake unto you, saying, You are spies:
live.canon|genesis|42:15: Hereby you shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh you shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.
live.canon|genesis|42:16: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and you shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether there be any truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely you are spies.
live.canon|genesis|42:19: If you be true men, let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go you, carry corn for the famine of your houses:
live.canon|genesis|42:22: And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do not sin against the child; and you would not hear? therefore, behold, also his blood is required.
live.canon|genesis|42:28: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, it is even in my sack: and their heart failed them, and they were afraid, saying one to another, What is this that Elohim (God) has done unto us?
live.canon|genesis|42:33: And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that you are true men; leave one of your brethren here with me, and take food for the famine of your households, and be gone:
live.canon|genesis|42:34: And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that you are no spies, but that you are true men: so will I deliver you your brother, and you shall traffick in the land.
live.canon|genesis|42:36: And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have you bereaved of my children: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and you will take Benjamin away: all these things are against me.
live.canon|genesis|42:37: And Reuben spake unto his father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to you: deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to you again.
live.canon|genesis|42:38: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he is left alone: if mischief befall him by the way in the which you go, then shall you bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
live.canon|genesis|42:2: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.
live.canon|genesis|42:3: And Joseph’s ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.
live.canon|genesis|42:4: But Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.
live.canon|genesis|42:5: And the sons of Yashar'el (Israel) came to buy corn among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.
live.canon|genesis|42:6: And Joseph was the governor over the land, and he it was that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph’s brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth.
live.canon|genesis|42:8: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.
live.canon|genesis|42:17: And he put them all together into ward three days.
live.canon|genesis|42:18: And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; for I fear Elohim (God):
live.canon|genesis|42:21: And they said one to another, We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.
live.canon|genesis|42:23: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.
live.canon|genesis|42:24: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.
live.canon|genesis|42:25: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man’s money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.
live.canon|genesis|42:26: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.
live.canon|genesis|42:27: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it was in his sack’s mouth.
live.canon|genesis|42:29: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and told him all that befell unto them; saying,
live.canon|genesis|42:30: The man, who is the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.
live.canon|genesis|42:31: And we said unto him, We are true men; we are no spies:
live.canon|genesis|42:32: We be twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.
live.canon|genesis|42:35: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man’s bundle of money was in his sack: and when both they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.
live.canon|genesis|42:20: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and you shall not die. And they did so.
live.canon|genesis|43:3: And Yahudah (Judah) spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, You shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.
live.canon|genesis|43:4: If you will send our brother with us, we will go down and buy you food:
live.canon|genesis|43:5: But if you will not send him, we will not go down: for the man said unto us, You shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.
live.canon|genesis|43:6: And Yashar'el (Israel) said, Wherefore dealt you so ill with me, as to tell the man whether you had yet a brother?
live.canon|genesis|43:7: And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have you another brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?
live.canon|genesis|43:8: And Yahudah (Judah) said unto Yashar'el (Israel) his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and you, and also our little ones.
live.canon|genesis|43:9: I will be surety for him; of my hand shall you require him: if I bring him not unto you, and set him before you, then let me bear the blame for ever:
live.canon|genesis|43:23: And he said, Peace be to you, fear not: your Elohim (God), and the Elohim (God) of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.
live.canon|genesis|43:27: And he asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well, the old man of whom you spake? Is he yet alive?
live.canon|genesis|43:28: And they answered, Your servant our father is in good health, he is yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.
live.canon|genesis|43:29: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother’s son, and said, Is this your younger brother, of whom you spake unto me? And he said, Elohim (God) be gracious unto you, my son.
live.canon|genesis|43:1: And the famine was sore in the land.
live.canon|genesis|43:2: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.
live.canon|genesis|43:10: For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time.
live.canon|genesis|43:11: And their father Yashar'el (Israel) said unto them, If it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:
live.canon|genesis|43:12: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight:
live.canon|genesis|43:13: Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:
live.canon|genesis|43:14: And El Shaddai (God Almighty) give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.
live.canon|genesis|43:15: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.
live.canon|genesis|43:16: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring these men home, and slay, and make ready; for these men shall dine with me at noon.
live.canon|genesis|43:17: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph’s house.
live.canon|genesis|43:18: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph’s house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.
live.canon|genesis|43:19: And they came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they communed with him at the door of the house,
live.canon|genesis|43:20: And said, O sir, we came indeed down at the first time to buy food:
live.canon|genesis|43:21: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, every man’s money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.
live.canon|genesis|43:22: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.
live.canon|genesis|43:24: And the man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.
live.canon|genesis|43:25: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.
live.canon|genesis|43:26: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.
live.canon|genesis|43:30: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.
live.canon|genesis|43:31: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.
live.canon|genesis|43:32: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
live.canon|genesis|43:33: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.
live.canon|genesis|43:34: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin’s mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.
live.canon|genesis|44:4: And when they were gone out of the city, and not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when you do overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have you rewarded evil for good?
live.canon|genesis|44:5: Is not this it in which my lord drinks, and whereby indeed he divineth? you have done evil in so doing.
live.canon|genesis|44:7: And they said unto him, Wherefore says my lord these words? Elohim (God) forbid that your servants should do according to this thing:
live.canon|genesis|44:8: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again unto you out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of your lord’s house silver or gold?
live.canon|genesis|44:9: With whomsoever of your servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord’s bondmen.
live.canon|genesis|44:10: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and you shall be blameless.
live.canon|genesis|44:15: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that you have done? wot you not that such a man as I can certainly divine?
live.canon|genesis|44:16: And Yahudah (Judah) said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? Elohim (God) has found out the iniquity of your servants: behold, we are my lord’s servants, both we, and he also with whom the cup is found.
live.canon|genesis|44:18: Then Yahudah (Judah) came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let your servant, I pray you, speak a word in my lord’s ears, and let not your anger burn against your servant: for you are even as Pharaoh.
live.canon|genesis|44:19: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have you a father, or a brother?
live.canon|genesis|44:20: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loves him.
live.canon|genesis|44:21: And you saidst unto your servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set my eyes upon him.
live.canon|genesis|44:23: And you saidst unto your servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, you shall see my face no more.
live.canon|genesis|44:24: And it came to pass when we came up unto your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
live.canon|genesis|44:27: And your servant my father said unto us, You know that my wife bare me two sons:
live.canon|genesis|44:29: And if you take this also from me, and mischief befall him, you shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
live.canon|genesis|44:30: Now therefore when I come to your servant my father, and the lad be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad’s life;
live.canon|genesis|44:31: It shall come to pass, when he sees that the lad is not with us, that he will die: and your servants shall bring down the gray hairs of your servant our father with sorrow to the grave.
live.canon|genesis|44:32: For your servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto you, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.
live.canon|genesis|44:33: Now therefore, I pray you, let your servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.
live.canon|genesis|44:1: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man’s money in his sack’s mouth.
live.canon|genesis|44:2: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.
live.canon|genesis|44:3: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.
live.canon|genesis|44:6: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words.
live.canon|genesis|44:11: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.
live.canon|genesis|44:12: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.
live.canon|genesis|44:13: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.
live.canon|genesis|44:14: And Yahudah (Judah) and his brethren came to Joseph’s house; for he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.
live.canon|genesis|44:17: And he said, Elohim (God) forbid that I should do so: but the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.
live.canon|genesis|44:22: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.
live.canon|genesis|44:25: And our father said, Go again, and buy us a little food.
live.canon|genesis|44:26: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man’s face, except our youngest brother be with us.
live.canon|genesis|44:28: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:
live.canon|genesis|44:34: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.
live.canon|genesis|45:3: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; does my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.
live.canon|genesis|45:4: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.
live.canon|genesis|45:5: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you sold me hither: for Elohim (God) did send me before you to preserve life.
live.canon|genesis|45:6: For these two years has the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.
live.canon|genesis|45:8: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but Elohim (God): and he has made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.
live.canon|genesis|45:9: Haste you, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus says your son Joseph, Elohim (God) has made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:
live.canon|genesis|45:10: And you shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you shall be near unto me, you, and your children, and your children’s children, and your flocks, and your herds, and all that you have:
live.canon|genesis|45:11: And there will I nourish you; for yet there are five years of famine; lest you, and your household, and all that you have, come to poverty.
live.canon|genesis|45:12: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaks unto you.
live.canon|genesis|45:13: And you shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen; and you shall haste and bring down my father hither.
live.canon|genesis|45:17: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto your brethren, This do you; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;
live.canon|genesis|45:18: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and you shall eat the fat of the land.
live.canon|genesis|45:19: Now you are commanded, this do you; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
live.canon|genesis|45:24: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that you fall not out by the way.
live.canon|genesis|45:1: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.
live.canon|genesis|45:2: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.
live.canon|genesis|45:7: And Elohim (God) sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
live.canon|genesis|45:14: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin’s neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.
live.canon|genesis|45:15: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.
live.canon|genesis|45:16: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, Joseph’s brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.
live.canon|genesis|45:20: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.
live.canon|genesis|45:21: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.
live.canon|genesis|45:22: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.
live.canon|genesis|45:23: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.
live.canon|genesis|45:25: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,
live.canon|genesis|45:26: And told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob’s heart fainted, for he believed them not.
live.canon|genesis|45:27: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:
live.canon|genesis|45:28: And Yashar'el (Israel) said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.
live.canon|genesis|46:3: And he said, I am Elohim (God), the Elohim (God) of your father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of you a great nation:
live.canon|genesis|46:4: I will go down with you into Egypt; and I will also surely bring you up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon your eyes.
live.canon|genesis|46:1: And Yashar'el (Israel) took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the Elohim (God) of his father Isaac.
live.canon|genesis|46:2: And Elohim (God) spake unto Yashar'el (Israel) in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.
live.canon|genesis|46:5: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba: and the sons of Yashar'el (Israel) carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
live.canon|genesis|46:6: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:
live.canon|genesis|46:7: His sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.
live.canon|genesis|46:8: And these are the names of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.
live.canon|genesis|46:9: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.
live.canon|genesis|46:10: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.
live.canon|genesis|46:11: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
live.canon|genesis|46:12: And the sons of Yahudah (Judah); Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zerah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.
live.canon|genesis|46:13: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.
live.canon|genesis|46:14: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.
live.canon|genesis|46:15: These be the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padan-aram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.
live.canon|genesis|46:16: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.
live.canon|genesis|46:17: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.
live.canon|genesis|46:18: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.
live.canon|genesis|46:19: The sons of Rachel Jacob’s wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.
live.canon|genesis|46:20: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.
live.canon|genesis|46:21: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.
live.canon|genesis|46:22: These are the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.
live.canon|genesis|46:23: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.
live.canon|genesis|46:24: And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.
live.canon|genesis|46:25: These are the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.
live.canon|genesis|46:26: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were threescore and six;
live.canon|genesis|46:27: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.
live.canon|genesis|46:28: And he sent Yahudah (Judah) before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.
live.canon|genesis|46:29: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Yashar'el (Israel) his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
live.canon|genesis|46:31: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father’s house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father’s house, which were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;
live.canon|genesis|46:33: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?
live.canon|genesis|46:30: And Yashar'el (Israel) said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen your face, because you are yet alive.
live.canon|genesis|46:32: And the men are shepherds, for their trade has been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.
live.canon|genesis|46:34: That you shall say, Your servants’ trade has been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
live.canon|genesis|47:15: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in your presence? for the money fails.
live.canon|genesis|47:18: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide it from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also has our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:
live.canon|genesis|47:19: Wherefore shall we die before your eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.
live.canon|genesis|47:23: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and you shall sow the land.
live.canon|genesis|47:24: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that you shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.
live.canon|genesis|47:25: And they said, You have saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.
live.canon|genesis|47:29: And the time drew nigh that Yashar'el (Israel) must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in your sight, put, I pray you, your hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray you, in Egypt:
live.canon|genesis|47:30: But I will lie with my fathers, and you shall carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as you have said.
live.canon|genesis|47:1: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.
live.canon|genesis|47:2: And he took some of his brethren, even five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.
live.canon|genesis|47:7: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
live.canon|genesis|47:9: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.
live.canon|genesis|47:10: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.
live.canon|genesis|47:11: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
live.canon|genesis|47:12: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father’s household, with bread, according to their families.
live.canon|genesis|47:13: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.
live.canon|genesis|47:14: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.
live.canon|genesis|47:3: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Your servants are shepherds, both we, and also our fathers.
live.canon|genesis|47:4: They said moreover unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for your servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray you, let your servants dwell in the land of Goshen.
live.canon|genesis|47:5: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Your father and your brethren are come unto you:
live.canon|genesis|47:6: The land of Egypt is before you; in the best of the land make your father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if you know any men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.
live.canon|genesis|47:8: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old are you?
live.canon|genesis|47:16: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.
live.canon|genesis|47:17: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.
live.canon|genesis|47:20: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh’s.
live.canon|genesis|47:21: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof.
live.canon|genesis|47:22: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.
live.canon|genesis|47:26: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part; except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh’s.
live.canon|genesis|47:27: And Yashar'el (Israel) dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.
live.canon|genesis|47:28: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.
live.canon|genesis|47:31: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Yashar'el (Israel) bowed himself upon the bed’s head.

live.canon|genesis|48:2: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, your son Joseph comes unto you: and Yashar'el (Israel) strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.
live.canon|genesis|48:4: And said unto me, Behold, I will make you fruitful, and multiply you, and I will make of you a multitude of people; and will give this land to your seed after you for an everlasting possession.

live.canon|genesis|48:20: And he blessed them that day, saying, In you shall Yashar'el (Israel) bless, saying, Elohim (God) make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

live.canon|genesis|48:14: And Yashar'el (Israel) stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the firstborn.

live.canon|genesis|48:16: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.
live.canon|genesis|48:17: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head unto Manasseh’s head.
live.canon|genesis|48:19: And his father refused, and said, I know it, my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.
live.canon|genesis|48:21: And Yashar'el (Israel) said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but Elohim (God) shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.

live.canon|genesis|50:8: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father’s house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.
live.canon|genesis|50:9: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.

live.canon|genesis|50:11: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abel-mizraim, which is beyond Jordan.

live.canon|genesis|50:14: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
live.canon|genesis|50:15: And when Joseph’s brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.
live.canon|genesis|50:19: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of Elohim (God)?
