live.canon|matthew|13:22: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that hears the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.

live.canon|matthew|13:1: The same day went Yahusha (Jesus) out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
live.canon|matthew|13:2: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
live.canon|matthew|13:3: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
live.canon|matthew|13:4: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:
live.canon|matthew|13:5: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
live.canon|matthew|13:6: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
live.canon|matthew|13:7: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
live.canon|matthew|13:8: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.
live.canon|matthew|13:11: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
live.canon|matthew|13:13: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
live.canon|matthew|13:15: For this people’s heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
live.canon|matthew|13:16: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
live.canon|matthew|13:24: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:
live.canon|matthew|13:25: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
live.canon|matthew|13:26: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
live.canon|matthew|13:31: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
live.canon|matthew|13:33: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
live.canon|matthew|13:27: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, did not you sow good seed in your field? from whence then has it tares?
live.canon|matthew|13:34: All these things spake Yahusha (Jesus) unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
live.canon|matthew|13:35: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
live.canon|matthew|13:36: Then Yahusha (Jesus) sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
live.canon|matthew|13:38: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
live.canon|matthew|13:39: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
live.canon|matthew|13:40: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
live.canon|matthew|13:41: The Son of Adam shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
live.canon|matthew|13:42: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
live.canon|matthew|13:45: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
live.canon|matthew|13:46: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
live.canon|matthew|13:47: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
live.canon|matthew|13:48: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
live.canon|matthew|13:49: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
live.canon|matthew|13:50: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
live.canon|matthew|13:53: And it came to pass, that when Yahusha (Jesus) had finished these parables, he departed thence.

live.canon|matthew|15:16: And Yahusha (Jesus) said, Are you also yet without understanding?
live.canon|matthew|15:17: Do not you yet understand, that whatsoever enters in at the mouth goes into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?

live.canon|matthew|15:10: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:

live.canon|matthew|15:15: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.

live.canon|matthew|15:31: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel).

live.canon|matthew|16:16: And Simon Peter answered and said, You are the Messiah (Christ), the Son of the living Elohim (God).
live.canon|matthew|16:17: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto him, Blessed are you, Simon Bar-jona: for flesh and blood has not revealed it unto you, but my Father which is in heaven.
live.canon|matthew|16:18: And I say also unto you, That you are Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
live.canon|matthew|16:19: And I will give unto you the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever you shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever you shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

live.canon|matthew|16:7: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.
live.canon|matthew|16:12: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

live.canon|matthew|16:20: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Yahusha (Jesus) the Messiah (Christ).
live.canon|matthew|16:21: From that time forth began Yahusha (Jesus) to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.

live.canon|matthew|18:21: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?

live.canon|matthew|19:21: Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, If you will be perfect, go and sell that you have, and give to the poor, and you shall have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.
live.canon|matthew|19:27: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed you; what shall we have therefore?
live.canon|matthew|19:28: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That you which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Adam shall sit in the throne of his glory, you also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|matthew|19:29: And every one that has forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.

live.canon|matthew|19:10: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.

threads.title: The ten virgins — oil in the vessel, the shut door, and I know you not (Ezekiel 36; Zechariah 4; Matthew 7)
threads.summary_md:
It ain't new. Ten virgins go out to meet the bridegroom, all with lamps, and the parable turns on one thing they did not all carry:

*They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:* (Matthew 25:3)

*But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.* (Matthew 25:4)

A lamp with no oil burns for a while on what it was lit with and then goes out. The prophets had already said what fills the vessel so the lamp keeps burning, and it is not the lamp:

*A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.* (Ezekiel 36:26)

*And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep my judgments, and do them.* (Ezekiel 36:27)

*But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el (Israel); After those days, saith Yahuah (LORD), I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people.* (Jeremiah 31:33)

The Spirit put within, and the Torah written in the heart so that a man walks in the statutes: that is oil in the vessel. Zechariah saw a lampstand that burned because oil was fed to it, and heard what the oil was:

*And said unto me, What seest thou? And I said, I have looked, and behold a candlestick all of gold, with a bowl upon the top of it, and his seven lamps thereon, and seven pipes to the seven lamps, which are upon the top thereof:* (Zechariah 4:2)

*Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of Yahuah (LORD) unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).* (Zechariah 4:6)

Then the door:

*And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.* (Matthew 25:10)

*Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Adonai (Lord), Adonai (Lord), open to us.* (Matthew 25:11)

*But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.* (Matthew 25:12)

Mark who is outside. Not strangers, not the tares, but virgins who went out to meet him, with lamps, calling him *Adonai (Lord)*. They are of the house, and the door is shut on them. He had said it before, and said what the shut door is about:

*Not every one that saith unto me, Adonai (Lord), Adonai (Lord), shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.* (Matthew 7:21)

*And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.* (Matthew 7:23)

Luke has the same knock and the same answer:

*When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Adonai (Lord), Adonai (Lord), open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:* (Luke 13:25)

Yahuah (the LORD) shut a door once before, on the whole earth, with the ones inside who had done as he commanded:

*And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as Elohim (God) had commanded him: and Yahuah (LORD) shut him in.* (Genesis 7:16)

The virgins outside had the lamp and the name and the right road, and no oil. The sifting at the door is of the house, the ones who called him *Adonai (Lord)* and did not walk in the statutes, and the warning is to the house:

*Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of Adam cometh.* (Matthew 25:13)
